            ImageFilter::Blur(blur) => Ok(Self::new(*blur, child)),
            ImageFilter::Matrix(matrix) => Ok(Self::matrix(*matrix, child)),
            _ => Ok(Self { image_filter: Some(filter), ..Self::new(GaussianBlur::uniform(0.0), child) }),
        }
